title: 「The Idea That 句」
titleEn: Using the idea that to name the content of a view or concept

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: The idea that + complete clause + singular verb / complement

formulas.formula: The idea that + complete clause + singular verb / complement
Subject + verb + the idea that + complete clause
Subject + preposition + the idea that + complete clause

rules.zh: That 後面必須是完整子句 That 後面需要有自己的主語和動詞。 ＝ everyone 是主語，deserves 是動詞。
rules.en: That must be followed by a complete clause with its own subject and verb; in everyone deserves respect, everyone is the subject and deserves is the verb.
examples: The idea that everyone deserves respect is important.

rules.zh: 整個 the idea that 子句通常視為單數 當 The idea that... 放在句首作主語時，後面的動詞通常使用單數形式。
rules.en: Treat the whole the idea that-clause as singular when it functions as the subject, so the following verb is normally singular.
examples: The idea that everyone can succeed is encouraging.

rules.zh: 本練習需要保留 that 在日常口語中，部分 that 可以省略；不過，在 the idea that 這個句型中，保留 that 通常更清楚和 自然。
rules.en: Keep that in the target structure for this lesson. Although some instances of that can be omitted in everyday speech, retaining it in the idea that is normally clearer and more natural.

rules.zh: The idea that 與 The fact that 的分別 表示一個想法、觀點、構想、建議或假設。 說話者不一定認為內容已經獲得證實。 這是一個可以討論或質疑的觀點。 表示說話者把內容視為已知、真實或已獲證實的事實。 辦公室提早關門被視為已經發生的事實。 簡單分辨方法 ● the idea that：這是某人的想法，但未必是真的。 ● the fact that：這件事被視為真實或已經發生。
rules.en: The idea that introduces a thought, view, concept, proposal or hypothesis that the speaker does not necessarily regard as proven and that may be debated or challenged. The fact that presents content as known, true or established. In short, the idea that identifies someone’s idea, which may not be true, while the fact that identifies something treated as true or as having happened.
examples: the idea that：這是某人的想法，但未必是真的。
the fact that：這件事被視為真實或已經發生。
The idea that longer hours always improve productivity is questionable.
The fact that the office closed early surprised everyone.

rules.zh: The idea that 與 The idea of 的結構不同 the idea that + 完整子句 the idea of + 名詞／動名詞 本練習的目標是 the idea that + 完整子句。
rules.en: The idea that and the idea of have different structures: use the idea that + complete clause, but the idea of + noun or gerund. This lesson targets the idea that + complete clause.
examples: The idea that she might leave worried us.
The idea of leaving worried her.

benefits.zh: 清楚指出某個觀點的內容 這個句型可以把一個完整觀點放在 that 後面，讓讀者立即知道正在討論甚麼。
benefits.en: It clearly states the content of an idea by placing a complete proposition after that, so readers immediately know what view is under discussion.
examples: The idea that everyone learns differently is important.

benefits.zh: 討論觀點時，不必表示它一定正確 使用 the idea that，你可以介紹、分析或批評一個觀點，而不需要把它當作事實。 這句是在評論一個觀點，而不是確認金錢真的能保證幸福。
benefits.en: It lets you introduce, analyse or criticize a view without presenting it as proven. The example comments on a belief about money and happiness rather than confirming it as true.
examples: The idea that money guarantees happiness is misleading.

benefits.zh: 讓整個觀點成為句子的主語或受詞 一個完整想法原本可能需要幾句才能說明。使用這個句型後，可以把整個想法當作一個「東西」來 討論。
benefits.en: It turns a whole idea into a subject or object, allowing an entire proposition that might otherwise take several sentences to be treated as one thing for discussion.
examples: The idea that exams measure intelligence worries many students.
Many students reject the idea that exams measure intelligence.

benefits.zh: 學生經常重複使用： 使用 the idea that 可以令句式更多元。
benefits.en: It avoids repeatedly using Some people think that and gives sentence structure greater variety.
examples: The idea that employees work best under pressure is not always correct.

benefits.zh: 適合用於作文、討論、報告及工作場合 你可以在句型前後加入不同的評價詞和動詞，例如： 這能幫助你更準確地表達自己對某個觀點的態度。
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, discussions, reports and the workplace. You can combine it with verbs and expressions such as support, reject, question or discuss the idea that; be based on the idea that; and disagree with the idea that, expressing your attitude to a view more precisely.
examples: be based on the idea that

questions.prompt: A healthy debate requires us to distinguish what someone thinks may be true from what has already been proved.
questions.promptZh: 健康的討論要求我們分清某人認為可能是真的事情，以及已經獲得證實的事情。
